_**Agent (copilot/gpt-5.2)**_

Status looks pretty solid for “no self-service signup; admin creates users; lists are owner-only writable; viewers are read-only”.

The one place where your *intent* (“self-service disabled”) and the *current code* don’t perfectly match is: **the better-auth public sign-up endpoints likely still exist**, even if you don’t link to them in the UI. Right now you’re only using sign-up in the bootstrap path (first user), but an attacker could potentially call `/api/auth/...` directly if better-auth keeps `signUpEmail` enabled when `emailAndPassword.enabled: true`.

Also, there’s one subtle privilege-escalation footgun in your better-auth config:

- In [src/lib/auth.ts](src/lib/auth.ts) you currently do `requestedRole = (user as ...).role` and then set `role: isFirstUser ? "admin" : requestedRole ?? "user"`.
  - If any public sign-up path can pass a `role` field (now or later), that becomes “self-assign admin”.

So: I agree the *main* data authorization (lists) looks correct (no foreign list writes / IDOR seen), and server actions don’t “leak” just by being exported because they all enforce session/ownership checks. But I do **not** want to leave the auth layer in a state where “signup is only disabled by UI”.

I’m going to harden this now in two surgical changes:
1) Ignore `requestedRole` entirely (only first user becomes admin; everyone else becomes user)
2) Block `/api/auth/sign-up/*` after the DB has any users (so self-service stays off even if someone hits the endpoint directly)

I’ll implement that now.

+
+### Security + diagnostics toggles
+
+This app intentionally runs with **no public registration UI**. However, auth endpoints still exist under `/api/auth/*` (Better Auth).
+To keep deployments safe by default, the app gates certain behaviors behind env flags.
+
+- `ALLOW_PUBLIC_SIGNUP` (default: disabled)
+	- When unset/falsey, requests to auth *sign-up* endpoints return `404` once the DB has any users.
+	- Bootstrap still works when the database is empty (the first user can be created).
+	- Set to `1`/`true`/`yes` to temporarily enable public signup endpoints.
+
+- `ALLOW_PUBLIC_DIAGNOSTICS` (default: disabled)
+	- When unset/falsey, `/env` is admin-only.
+	- Set to `1`/`true`/`yes` to make `/env` publicly accessible as a deployment sanity check.
+
+Notes:
+
+- Env values are loaded via `process.env` and (optionally) `dotenvx` based on `NODE_ENV` (see [src/lib/env.ts](src/lib/env.ts)).
+- Prefer enabling these only briefly during first deploy / recovery, then disabling.
*** End Patch
